tests.description: Four controlled browser integration journeys covering Home/Settings and stale success/failure across real same-account sign-out/sign-in; one real token refresh stability journey.

fixture_needs.name: createEventLoadSessionControl
requirements: Install one interceptNetworkCall handler eagerly at creation, before initial page.goto. Match GET **/rest/v1/events*; no page.route.

install(): Promise<void> installs an observer wrapper around the ORIGINAL store.loadEvents after Mood is ready. Wrapper calls the production function unchanged, records sequential invocation and settled result.status, and returns that same result. Restore original action in dispose.
holdNext({status:200|400,rows:EventWireRow[]}): gate or Promise<gate>; gate has invocation:number, waitForRequests():Promise<void>, release():Promise<{upcomingStatus:number,pastStatus:number}>.

Hold both parallel event_date=gte.* and event_date=lt.* requests for one load. On release upcoming responds chosen status (rows for 200, valid PostgREST error envelope for 400); past returns 200 and [].

release() witnesses BOTH actual Request.response() objects and finished response bodies before resolving statuses. The intercept utility handler result resolves at request capture and has synthetic status; it cannot prove completion.

Unexpected event requests must fail with clear diagnostics; never silently fabricate queue behavior. dispose releases held gates, settles outstanding handlers and removes its own interception/observer without touching unrelated routes or shared accounts.

fixture_needs.name: createSessionEventRow
requirements: Generate unique UUID id and valid future event_date (one anchor, local calendar components, now + 30 days), created_at and updated_at ISO instants, null description, calendar icon. Accept label override. No database writes required.

playwright_utils_deviations.reason: The second login intentionally uses the real login form because ending and reopening the same account auth lifetime is the behavior under test; configured auth-session fixtures still provide each initial worker session.

Application-specific dual-window request completion tracking must use captured Request.response()/Response.finished(): installed interceptNetworkCall custom-handler mode resolves at request capture and returns a synthetic status before fulfillment. The utility still owns interception.

selector_verification.method: Root verified the live login snapshot with Playwright CLI at http://localhost:5173 (Email, Password, Sign In), then closed its named session. Remaining selectors confirmed against current source and existing E2E conventions; final runtime verification is parent step 4.

summary: Generated 5 runnable-target TypeScript tests (4 P1, 1 P2), without running tests or generating fixtures. The four P1 tests settle the old load after same-user reauthentication and before any successor load; this prevents latestLoadId from masking a broken authSessionVersion check. Real auth transitions and UI event consumers execute; only event wire responses are controlled. No API response schema was found for events; generated rows use Database event Row typing and assertions cover observed statuses, event identities, load results and UI. Initial auth fixtures, worker pool isolation, utility interception, recurse and report logging are reused.
validation_adjustments: Use log singleton and boolean predicate returns to match installed APIs.
Observe both Settings StrictMode mount loads explicitly and sort only the assertion view of their real results.
Use HTTP400 because the production Supabase client retries503 reads.
